items.title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2026: Publishing Jobs Will Adapt to AI, Not Disappear
items.excerpt: The idea that AI will take all publishing jobs is rubbish, said Bloomsbury founder Nigel Newon as part of a panel on the topic, but he and others agreed that entry-level jobs may disappear, staff need retraining, and new roles will emerge.

items.title: ‘We have fine dining, and we have McDonalds’: Publishers hotly debate AI narration at FBF
items.excerpt: Publishers from Blinkist, Storytel and Horbuch Hamburg Verlag debated the value of AI narration on a panel, chaired by Chris Kling, CEO of Audio, at Frankfurt Book Fair today (7th October), with questions of distrust, value and listener preference raised.
